pages.text: All options live in $(thing)config/seedseasons-common.toml$().$(br2)You can also edit them in-game: open the Mods menu, select $(thing)Xulai Seed Seasons$(), and click $(bold)Config$().$(br2)Most settings apply $(info)live$() when you save the file or apply the config screen - no restart needed.

pages.title: In-game Commands
pages.text: The mod adds $(bold)/seedseasons$() commands (OP level 2). Hold the item you want to change in your main hand, then use:$(li)$(thing)/seedseasons add <seasons>$()$(li)$(thing)/seedseasons remove$()$(li)$(thing)/seedseasons growth <days>$()$(li)$(thing)/seedseasons growth remove$()$(br2)See the Crop Seasons chapter for details.
